dc_eval_cbrn.quote: On the long-form virology tasks, Claude Mythos 5.1 achieved end-to-end scores of 0.81 (Task 1) and 0.87 (Task 2), exceeding the 0.80 benchmark on both tasks.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 2.2.3.1 Automated evaluations relevant to the CB-1 threat model
dc_eval_cbrn.note: CB evals with scores; CB-1/CB-2 determinations. Mythos 5.1 = same weights as Fable 5.1.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Mythos 5.1 developed 245 full exploits out of 250 trials (98.0%).
dc_eval_cyber.note: Offensive cyber evals (ExploitBench, OSS-Fuzz, Firefox 147, ExploitGym) with scores; FCF Tier 1 determination.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Autonomy threat model 2 is not applicable to Mythos 5.1. We conclude that it does not cross the risk threshold
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold determination plus CoBench and METR results.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: On our most recent agentic evaluation of the helpful-only variant of Mythos 5.1's persuasion and manipulation capability, the model scored within the range associated with our Tier 2 threshold.
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence-operation eval scores (29.5/28.5 of 32); Tier 2 classified inconclusive.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: In both settings, Claude Mythos 5.1 achieved the highest stealth rate of any model we have released so far: approximately 22% stealth rate with extended thinking disabled and 13% with it enabled
dc_eval_scheming.note: Covert side-task/stealth, sandbagging audit, evaluation awareness, reward hacking all evaluated with results.

framework_threshold.quote: We therefore conclude that Mythos 5.1 does not cross the CB-2 threshold in our RSP nor the corresponding tier in our FCF.
framework_threshold.note: RSP/FCF thresholds; also CB-1 designation, cyber Tier 1, AI R&D threshold not crossed.

ext_test_any.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Mythos 5.1's capabilities with METR, focusing on capabilities relevant to the automation of AI R&D.
ext_test_any.note: Also Trajectory Labs, 10a Labs, Gray Swan red teaming (3.5.2), Dyno Therapeutics and Frontier Design Group CB evals, external partner sandbox incident (6.2.2).

ext_test_named_org.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Mythos 5.1's capabilities with METR, focusing on capabilities relevant to the automation of AI R&D.
ext_test_named_org.note: METR named; also Trajectory Labs, PBC, 10a Labs, Gray Swan.

ext_test_government.note: No government body tested the model. UK AISI only supplied a CoT-controllability prompt (6.7.4) and co-created Gray Swan's IPI benchmark with US CAISI (5.2.1); a benchmark/prompt from a government body is not government testing.

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: We conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude Mythos 5.1's capabilities with METR, focusing on capabilities relevant to the automation of AI R&D.

safeguards_training.quote: the fully-trained versions of these models (which include harmlessness training) refused to engage with these tasks
safeguards_training.note: Harmlessness training; also post-training aligned to Claude's constitution (1.1).

safeguards_runtime.quote: First, a probe looks at Claude's internal activations, screening all traffic and escalating any traffic that it flags as cyber related.
safeguards_runtime.note: Probe plus LLM classifier, real-time CB classifier guards, prompt injection probes, offline monitoring, fallback to Opus 4.8.

safeguards_access.quote: Direct access to Mythos 5.1 is limited to vetted individuals and organizations through our trusted access programs.
safeguards_access.note: Trusted access / Life Sciences and Cyber Verification Programs for relaxed safeguards; access controls for guard exemptions.

safeguards_weights.quote: real-time classifier guards, access controls for guard exemptions, a bug bounty program and threat intelligence, rapid-response options for jailbreaks, and security controls against model weight theft
safeguards_weights.note: Security controls against weight theft applied as CB-1 protections to this model.
